name: Gambler
ability: Each night*, choose a player & guess their character: if you guess wrong, you die.
interaction: Points at any player (alive or dead, including themselves) and then at a character icon. Learns nothing.
drunk_or_poisoned: A wrong guess does not kill the Gambler.

rulings.text: Any player may be chosen, alive or dead, including the Gambler.
A correct guess does nothing; a wrong guess kills the Gambler. The Gambler is not told whether they were right.
A correct guess gives no protection: the Demon may still kill the Gambler that night.
Guesses are checked against the actual character, not a bluff: guessing Pacifist for a Devil's Advocate bluffing Pacifist is wrong.

test_scenarios.name: correct guess
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Gambler, Bob Minstrel, Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses Bob and guesses Minstrel.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice survives her guess (Carol may still kill her).

test_scenarios.name: wrong guess
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Gambler, Bob Devil's Advocate (claims Pacifist), Carol Imp.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Alice chooses Bob and guesses Pacifist.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice dies that night; her death is announced at dawn.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned Gambler
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Gambler, Bob Poisoner, Carol Imp, Dave Chef.
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Bob poisons Alice; Alice chooses Dave and guesses Empath.
test_scenarios.expected: Alice does not die from the wrong guess.
